response.rationale: C1 is an append-only completion of R2, so it retains R2's core JDM support while adding the raw-supported anti-TIF-1γ autoantibody modifier, making the diagnosis more etiologically and subtype complete. R2 is accurate but less specific; its broader raw spans are consistent but do not outweigh the added specificity. Margin is low because R2 already cites the same antibody span.
